asr.full_text: While notions like digital black markets and non national currencies may have seemed futuristic only a few years ago, today peer-to-peer anonymous exchanges are pioneering an entirely new way for the global community to think about financial systems. Imagine having the opportunity of being in the forefront of something new, something emerging and something future historians would refer to as revolutionary. Imagine being one of the first people that trade and mine a digital currency without having to use complex equipment and skills. Imagine being part of a concept that breathes by the people for the people with a real ambition of one world one coin well now this opportunity is spreading across the world One Coin is a new digital-created cryptocurrency that is now gaining ground and building an exclusive community of worldwide miners, traders and users, across a world that is adapting itself to the digital currencies that are emerging on our planet, the idea behind bitcoins, was to digitally replicate gold, kind of a gold standard for the internet. The idea of a decentralized currency is important because it removes those levers of power that people can exploit to corrupt. A few years ago, the first pioneering cryptocurrency, Bitcoin, was traded for less than 10 cents in the dollar. And a couple of years later, the value of Bitcoin was over $1100. OneCoin has been born out of Bitcoin's success, but with an innovative and refined concept. Aiming to reach their mass and to provide them access to the exciting and profitable world of cryptocurrency. We are seeing that miners and users of OneCoin growing. A new cryptocurrency has been born and is climbing its way to the top. The OneCoin currency is one of the biggest players with huge growth potential in the market. By joining the one concept, In today's episode we will be looking at how to make a profit from the cryptocurrency By joining the one concept, we will not only teach how to profit from the cryptocurrency but also how to position yourself in an unlimited revenue generating program where we are committed to make you successful by providing you with all the tools and inspiration you need to succeed. Our training and marketing tools combined with a solid and strong educational product, enhanced by an outstanding and simple payment plan is why today's entrepreneurs are joining the one concepts, we are committed to make you successful and provide all support you need to grow your team and business the world is yours one column

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes joining OneCoin through claims of profit and an "unlimited revenue generating program," while directing participants to grow a team and business. The description explicitly invites viewers to contact the promoter to join the "largest team build," making recruitment central to the earning opportunity rather than presenting neutral cryptocurrency education.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the promotion links earning potential to participation in a team-building structure: it promises an unlimited revenue program, provides support to help viewers grow their team and business, and advertises joining the largest team build. The supplied content does not establish a paid mining package, sensitive-data request, or specific token purchase mechanism, so those categories are not assigned.
